# Khalid Hasan Anik

> Khalid Hasan Anik is a Technical Project Coordinator at AWTOMATIG (an AI automation & BPO agency in Dhaka, Bangladesh) who also works hands-on as the company's full-stack developer, DevOps engineer, and AI automation builder.

Khalid coordinates project delivery for a small team while personally building the AI agents, RAG systems, automations, and web infrastructure that AWTOMATIG and its clients run on. Areas of focus: AI agents and RAG systems, workflow automation (n8n), full-stack web development (Next.js, React), DevOps (Docker, CI/CD, Linux VPS administration), and analytics/tracking (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads).

He holds a BSc in Computer Science and Engineering from North South University (2021–2025).

## Side Projects

- [Price Scout](https://utilbook.store): A price comparison search tool that finds a product across the web and returns the top 5 results sorted by price, with ratings and direct links.
